title: Chapter 528
paragraphs: Chapter 528
Episode 144. For a Friend (6)
Alone, Dante was swarmed by the swords of the Royal Guard.
Though the knights of the Hairan assault team were defending him, the numbers of the Royal Guard were too many.
Moreover, ordinary knights kept rushing at Dante.
Every time Dante moved, sharp flashes of light flickered.
Each time, at least one knight was killed.
He could not understand why ordinary knights rushed at him like moths to a flame, knowing they were no match for him.
‘I can't show mercy...!’
Between the body of a slain ordinary knight, the blade of the Royal Guard appeared.
He reflexively turned his head to dodge, but the blade grazed his forehead.
Blood from his forehead colored his eyeballs.
In the moment of wiping off the blood, an opening was created, and the Royal Guard didn't miss this opportunity.
If it weren't for another secret technique of the Emperor's Sword, the Dragon Sword Armor, even Dante would have been unable to avoid a fatal wound.
The blue aura that wrapped around Dante's body blocked the blade of the Royal Guard.
The aura didn’t stop there and instead stabbed into the chest of the Royal Guard like a thorn.
Blood spurted as the golden armor was mercilessly pierced.
The other Royal Guards, who had thrust their swords together without knowing the characteristics of the Dragon Sword Armor, were either fatally wounded or killed.
The Royal Guard is, of course, composed of outstanding talents that can't be compared with ordinary knights.
There were those who passed the student exam in their childhood and failed, who were generally considered geniuses or prodigies.
However, compared to Dante, they just seemed mediocre.
In terms of talent, effort, the will to overcome obstacles, and the motivation and determination to stand on this battlefield, Dante surpassed the knights of the Imperial Army in every aspect.
"Do you really think you can kill me? You guys have no chance, at least someone of the Royal Guard captain's level…!”
Dante stopped speaking and looked at a man standing in front of the Dragon Spear.
Alton Hairan, the Captain of the Royal Guard. He was Dante's relative, and he was a rider of Hairan before he became a member of the Royal Guard.
"Stop, Dante."
Dante let out a sarcastic laugh.

"Alton Hairan, my relative. My grandfather always said you were pathetic, but I tried to understand and respect you. The reason you became a Royal Guard wasn't because you lacked the qualifications or potential to become the next head of the Hairan family... I thought it was another form of loyalty to the family and the empire."
Dante slowly moved toward Alton.
Among the Royal Guard and ordinary knights who initially charged, those still alive kept lunging with their swords, but Dante cut off their breaths without taking his eyes off Alton.
"My grandfather was right. You're just trash who became the emperor's dog because you thought you couldn't have anything in Hairan and wanted to gain some pathetic power."
"Even now, if you stop, you can go back, Dante."
"Huh, what?"

"Pathetic power? I am the captain of the Royal Guard. If you show your surrender now and hand over a white stone to His Majesty, Hairan can continue to exist as a pillar of the empire. I swear on my name. Stop now. This slaughter doesn't suit you. Everything can be as if it never happened."
"Hahaha……!"
Dante's face distorted.
"You're mad, Alton Hairan. How many have already lost their lives? If I stop, will they come back alive? Will the fact that the Emperor drove Hairan into treason disappear?"
Stop talking nonsense!
Dante yelled with eyes blazing red.
"Our Hairan and the Empire, the fight will not end until one of them is destroyed."
"Foolish... Don't you have any sense of responsibility as a leader? If you don't stop, Hairan will be annihilated! Even its history will be wiped out without a trace."
Dante lunged, brandishing his sword.
Alton blocked Dante's sword head-on.
Clang-!
A loud noise and a shockwave erupted, and the imperial guards who were supposed to aid Alton couldn't dare approach.
Gulp-!
Dante spat out a chunk of blood.
Blood flowed from his eyes and ears, and his wrist, which was holding the clashing swords, felt as if the bones would fall out any moment.

"And what will you do with that body, as a leader what choice have you made? You're just driving yourself and your clan members into a dead end. A way for everyone to survive is right before your eyes!"
As if there was no value in replying anymore, Dante silently swung his sword.
As Alton said, his frail body seemed to have already surpassed its limits.
Yet, the fact that he could still move so sharply despite his trembling body meant that Dante was crossing a certain threshold as a warrior.
Contrary to his body, which was bleeding profusely, Dante's sword was emitting a brighter and stronger light. It was piercing into Alton faster and sharper.
Each time the swords clashed and cut through the air, the wind screamed sharply.
Fragments of sword energy flew around, creating a vortex, and the ground beneath their feet constantly gave way due to their movements.
Other knights nearby stood back, waiting for the shockwave to weaken. For those who had not reached a certain level, it was a fight they dared not approach.
It didn't take long for the outcome to be decided.
In the instant Alton tried to use Hairan's secret technique, Dante took advantage of the gap, cut off his wrist, and got behind him.
Thump-!
Dante's sword, which had pierced through Alton's back and came out through his chest, was stained crimson with blood.
As he twisted the sword, Alton twitched and shook his head.
Blood flowing from Dante's forehead kept spreading over his eyes.
For a moment, a few memories of Alton from their shared childhood passed through his mind.
The times when Alton, as his uncle, looked at him fondly, and the moments when he struggled to overcome the inferiority complex he had as an uncle towards his nephew.
But it was too late to feel sad.
Like a bubble bursting on the surface of the water, the rising thoughts did not really make Dante sad.
"Alton Hairan, Hairan never abandoned you, but you abandoned Hairan. Hairan never betrayed you, but you betrayed Hairan before anyone else. Paying for that sin with this death is far from enough."
"Cough, ah......"
Alton was also thinking of the same thing.
He was not as strong and sturdy as Dante. That's why he left Hairan, a little while ago he spoke of saving Hairan, and now he was making his last words.
"Stop... it."
Thud!
As Dante pulled out his sword, Alton fell forward, convulsing.
"Stop it, Zipple is coming... Dante."
His voice, facing imminent death, was so weak that his lips barely moved.
Dante did not hear the words that Zipple was coming.
Even if he had heard, his resolve would not have changed.
With Alton's death, the imperial forces had no choice but to be greatly shaken.
No one could have imagined that the captain of the Imperial Guards would die like this. Because the one who is breaking through the battlefield right now is not Ron, but Dante.
"Assault squad! Keep assisting the Lord!"
Like a ghost, Dante began to charge again towards the enemy's vanguard.
When they saw this, the nearby soldiers regained their fear, which had been covered by madness.
They couldn't dare to approach the Lord of Hairan.
About a hundred soldiers who had been waiting at the enemy's vanguard stepped back, and only the senior knights, including the Imperial Guards, barely pointed their swords at Dante.
The dragons behind the enemy vanguard roared.
The dragons all spewed their breath at once, and at that moment, the newly arrived knights of the Hairan assault team raised their swords to protect Dante.
"Please go ahead, my Lord!"

The knights of Hairan were not all monsters like Dante. The assault team's knights barely blocked the dragon's breath. It would have been fine if it was just breath, but red dragon-class and yellow dragon-class cannons from all over were aiming at Dante.
If we can take out the enemy's vanguard and get five swordsmen to arrive...
The knights of Hairan fired their sword energy at the dragons.
Cutting down the embers of the dragons that fell from the sword energy, Dante closed the distance with the enemy's vanguard.
While Dante and the assault team were opening the path, the enemy's vanguard fired two more shots at the Emperor's castle.
The wall where Dante had stood was completely collapsed, and the inner castle was clearly visible.
Although the fight was not targeting the castle, deep inside the inner castle was Ron, who was unconscious.
As a member of Hairan, and as the grandson of the Sword Emperor.
For Dante, Ron was still the greatest hope.
Even though the Emperor's castle is breaking and he is still unconscious, Dante believed that his beloved grandfather would surely wake up before the end of the war.
He will wake up and clearly show the enemies of Hairan what weight the name of the Sword Emperor carries... Dante believed so.
Without such hope, his tired and injured body would have already collapsed on the cold ground.
Dante took a rough breath and gripped his sword.
The enemy's vanguard was in front of him.
Up close, the enemy's vanguard was as gigantic as a mountain in front of you and was emanating a menacing aura that was hard to describe.
He slashed it with one strike.
The sword energy of the Imperial Sword, Heaven-piercing One Slash, left a shining afterimage as it split through the center of the enemy's vanguard.
The split enemy's vanguard collapsed to both sides, crushing the soldiers and mages who couldn't escape in time.

Dante hid momentarily in the cloud of dust and smoke created by the fallen dragon tower and knelt on one knee. And before the enemy could see him, he got up again and barely calmed his trembling body.
It was the moment Hairan achieved a small victory in this war.
"The Lord has slain the Imperial Guard Captain and the dragon tower!"
"The Emperor's dragon tower has collapsed...!"
But at that moment.
Kwaaaa-!
Kwaaaaa...!
From somewhere, a loud noise was heard.
Although it was distant, the sound was exactly the same as when the dragon tower spewed a bullet.
When he turned around, he saw the protective barrier and outer wall of the Sword Emperor's castle collapsing.
"Are there... more dragon towers?"
The dragon tower is the only main cannon in the empire.
But the Emperor had prepared for such a moment, creating replicas of the dragon tower, using Zipple's abilities.
"Kwaaaak!"
"Back, back... second dragon tower confirmed!"
"Henser's Magic Corps, Rillista's Magic Corps are operating the dragon tower! Minimum 4, no, 7, 9...!"
Dante was too far away to hear the desperate voices of the border knights.
However, even without hearing their report, he could easily tell that the situation was going terribly wrong.
"We can't hold the Sword Emperor's castle! We must evacuate!"
"Medic, medic...!"
"Where are we supposed to evacuate to, defend it! Defend it even if you die!"
"Scatter! Scatter so the cannons can't aim!"
It felt like all the blood in his body was cooling down.
'Again, from where, should I continue to advance and target the Emperor, no, the Sword Emperor's castle, the knights of Hairan, my grandfather...!'
Nausea rose.
Somehow, he had to hold on to his sanity and find a solution. It couldn't end like this.
Dante was engulfed in despair, and the Emperor smiled. But both Dante's despair and the Emperor's smile were...
Just for a moment.
From beyond the rear of the Sword Emperor's castle, a single, shining, massive sword energy was fiercely cutting through the gloomy night sky.
The unique bluish color produced by the mixture of thunder and aura.
There is only one person in the world who wields such a sword.
Therefore, those who witnessed that sword energy, all those on the battlefield, could realize in an instant.
That Jin Runcandel has arrived.
